scores.visual_critic_note: Genuine design intent shown in typography, depth-based opacity, and restrained control UI, but the circle pack is cropped at the bottom of the viewport (900px SVG overflows the render area) and the edge bundles — the core feature — are nearly invisible at 0.12 stroke opacity.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correct sqrt scale for force-layout circle sizing, data-driven extent domains, proper key functions on data joins, and equal-area sqrt radial scale on the sunburst partition; no bars/areas so baseline violations don't apply.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire updateLayout() with a full 1500ms Flubber transition on every input event with no debounce, and the force-sim tick redraws 300 link paths per frame with no RAF coalescing; no explicit .interrupt() is called before new transitions, leaving mid-flight node positions in an undefined intermediate state when layouts are switched rapidly.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view, interaction-first design keeps working memory load low — 201 nodes and 300 bundled edges are well-managed through containment hierarchy, 12%-opacity edge rendering, and a 10-hue palette that assigns one color per top-level subtree — but the 201-node simultaneous morph animation and slight viewport clipping of the outermost circle are unresolved perceptual risks.

proposer: Reduced link opacity from 0.35 to 0.12 and width from 1.5px to 1px so the hierarchy structure shows through the edge bundle tangle. Faded states are now near-invisible (0.03 opacity) to maximize highlight contrast. Highlight color shifted from `#f59e0b` to `#e8740c` for better contrast against the light background.
